title: Deliverable Canonical Consumer-Reader & Shape Conformance Inspector
l0_summary: Zero-dep canonical reader & defect detector for .xlsx, .docx, .pptx, .csv, .json, and .md deliverable artifacts.

filePath.description: Path to the deliverable file to inspect (relative to workspace or absolute)

expectedShape.description: Optional expected shape constraints (sheets, headers, strictColumns, headings, requiredKeys)

checkPlaceholders.description: Whether to check for unresolved placeholder leaks (default: true)
